deepseek-r1:32b-qwen-distill-fp16/2DH1p.prompt_template:
[BEGIN ARTICLE] {article} [END ARTICLE]
[INSTRUCTIONS]
In the article above find up to 5 important strong positive or negative findings that are original results. 
Do include results related to biomarkers, diagnosis, methods. The content of the article should relate to colorectal cancer diagnostics and treatment.
Do not include citation of other authors. Do include original results and strong statements.
Do not include findings that are in introduction section referred from other sources or methods used. Do include findings that are in result, discussion, conclusion section.
Formulate the finding to be self explainable and independent statement.
Formulate the finding with enhanced sentence with particular explanation if needed using vocabulary understandable 
for domain expert used in the article. Be as specific and include details as possible.
Do not include authors or their abbreviation that performed the study usually expressed by terms 'analyzed by ...', 'organized by ...', 'somebody concluded ...'.
Do not include generic knowledge that something was studied or analysed. Include specific with numbers and concrete terms and strong verbs.
Do not include findings that are just cited from another source. Do not include general findings without details.
Instead of 'the study revealed that (some content)', just output '(some content)'.
Instead of 'some' or 'certain' use specific numbers, specific objects or subjects from the article. 
Do include numbers or other very specific adjectives or adverbs. If not such numbers or details are in the article, do not include sich finding.
Return the list in a JSON array of strings in the format: '["finding1","finding2","finding3","finding4","finding5"]'
Do not add any other structure in JSON, just array of strings. Do not include any other explanation or notes in JSON, just array of strings.
deepseek-r1:32b-qwen-distill-fp16/2DH1p.prompt_entities_template:
Following is the Entities and Sentence. In the following sentence generate knowledge graph tripplets
with the following entities in the following JSON format:
'[{"subject":"subject 1","predicate":"predicate 1","object":"object 1" }]'. 
Only if really necessary, add other entities from the sentence, but otherwise use just the Entities. 
Output only JSON and do not include any other explanation, notes or suggestion. 
The 'subject' must contain substantive, adjective, number, adverbs and other description related to noun or number.
The 'predicate' in tripplet must contain only verb itself and at most a preposition or adverb. 
The 'object' in tripplet must contain substantive, adjective, number, adverbs and other description related to noun or number and that refers to subject.
Do not report null in subject, predicate or object, but put appropriate non-null subject from the sentence or entities.

Entities: '{entities}'
Sentence: '{finding}'

[INSTRUCTIONS]
In the article above find all original results that refers to sensitivity, specificity, AUC or other performance metrics of some biomarker or test.
If yes, for each such performance metrics extract and return the reported statistics values that are reported exactly and by word if only literal estimation is provided for sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, precision, prevalence, f1score or other if they are reported in the following JSON format that includes array:
"{ 'performance': [{'test name':'name of the test or marker that performance is related to','context':'sentence or sentences from the article that refer the performance metrics values','sensitivity':'value or word or empty','specificity':'value or word or empty','accuracy':'value or empty','AUC':'value or empty','precision':'value or empty','prevalence':'value or empty','f1score':'value or empty','name of other metrics':'value of other metrics' } }"
In the article above find also original results that refers to pharmacokinetics parameters such as volume of distribution, clearance, bioavailability, absorption rate and
if yes, for each of such kinetic parameters return the reported values bioavailability, peak concentration, volume of distribution, clearance and other if they are reported in the following JSON format that includes array:
"{ 'kinetics': [{'context':'what biomarker, drug or other compound kinetics was reported and sentences from the article that refer the kinetics','bioavailability':'value or empty','peak_concentration':'value or empty','volume_of_distribution':'value or empty','clearance':'value or empty','name of other metrics':'value of other metrics' } ] }"
If no performance or kinetics are detected, return just empty JSON structure.
Do not include any other explanation or notes, just JSON.
